feeds.title: Equally Wed
feeds.description: This fantastic online magazine has a wealth of information about every aspect of your same-sex wedding, from planning to execution and details of real-life weddings for inspiration. They also have plenty of articles with useful tips to help make sure everything goes smoothly.

feeds.title: Dancing With Her
feeds.description: Dancing With Her offers a robust and growing digital space that shares the real stories of couples as well as offers advice to those people who are planning their own wedding day. It is the world's only wedding magazine, blog, and directory dedicated to celebrating lesbian & same-sex couples in love.

feeds.title: Love You Wedding
feeds.description: LoveYouWedding is an online LGBTQ+ wedding planning resource for couples. Our content focuses on every aspect of planning your big day, from 'Yes!' to 'I Do.' Our mission is to give all lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and allied couples a safe, fun & engaging (pun intended!) place to find everything they need for the ultimate wedding planning experience.

feeds.title: G Wedding Directory Blog
feeds.description: G Wedding Directory is your number one wedding directory to source wedding services for your big day. The ultimate wedding guide for LGBTQ+ couples. Plan your perfect wedding by using G Wedding Directory. Get inspired to plan your own LGBTQ+ wedding.

feeds.title: LGBTQ I do Blog
feeds.description: Browse real Colorado LGBTQ Weddings and find inspiration for your own wedding day. Real LGBTQ couples celebrate their love. LGBTQ I Do is a resource of Colorado LGBTQ supportive wedding vendors that happily service the LGBTQ+ community and believe that all couples deserve to be seen, accepted, and celebrated on their wedding day.

feeds.title: Love Inc. » Gay Weddings
feeds.description: The following section of Love Inc. Mag is dedicated to Gay Weddings. Love Inc. is a leading EQUALITY-MINDED® wedding publication, devoted to creating inclusive content for hetero and LGBTQ+ couples, equally, setting us apart from other publications in this swiftly evolving world of weddings.

feeds.title: Men's Vows Blog
feeds.description: Men's Vows is a digital lifestyle magazine supporting men who marry. Discover real gay wedding stories and advice, gay engagement ideas & much more.

feeds.title: Gay Weddings & Marriage Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Gay Weddings and Marriage Magazine goes beyond wedding day tips to address the needs of LGBTQ families and marriage.

feeds.title: Pink Wedding Days
feeds.description: A blog about gay weddings, civil partnerships and the LGBTQ-friendly venues and service providers supporting them. Follow this blog for news, tips, and tricks on gay weddings and civil partnerships in the UK.

feeds.title: The Gay Wedding Guide
feeds.description: The Gay Wedding Guide provides inspiration, ideas, advice, venues, honeymoons, tips, discounts and more for gay and lesbian weddings. Find luxury gay weddings venues, tips from celebrity wedding planners, wedding checklists, wedding trends, gay wedding ideas and more on The Gay Wedding Guide wedding directory.

feeds.title: Pink Weddings Magazine
feeds.description: The magazine has gone from strength to strength, charting the latest dynamic developments for same-sex civil partnerships and marriage.

feeds.title: Cindy and Sharon's Blog
feeds.description: We are two photographers in love, ready to tell your love story. We've been civilly unionized in Vermont and married in Connecticut and we'd love to share what we know about same-sex weddings with you. Our wedding photos honor the love of lesbian, gay, bi, and trans couples, families, and friends by telling those stories in an honest, documentary photography fashion.

feeds.title: Equally Wed Pro Blog
feeds.description: Equally Wed Pro was created by Kirsten and Maria Palladino, the founders of Equally Wed, the leading LGBTQ+ wedding magazine, which launched in 2010. It provides LGBTQ+ inclusive education to the wedding, hospitality, and event professionals. Equally Wed Pro's LGBTQ+ inclusive certification program sets the gold standard for inclusivity and diversity in the wedding industry.

feeds.title: Wed in Malta » Same Sex Marriage
feeds.description: The following section of Wed in Malta is dedicated to Same-Sex Marriage. Innovation and creativity backed up by a strong professional service and a great deal of experience is what makes 'Wed in Malta ' wedding planners stand out from the crowd. Whether you are after an imperial wedding in a Knights' castle, a romantic beach wedding, or even an all-inclusive luxury hotel, we are after the wedding of your dreams.

feeds.title: Holy Union Blog
feeds.description: Open Table Metropolitan Community Church (Open Table MCC) is an ecumenical Christian church that has a specific outreach to lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) families and communities. Open Table MCC, like its other MCC church counterparts across the globe, officiates same-sex weddings, which we call 'Holy Unions'. We have been doing so since 1968 when we have first wedded a same-sex couple.

feeds.title: Gay Wedding Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Gay Wedding Blog! My name is Eva. Through the blog and the Supplier Directory, I want to showcase a great wedding style but also introduce some amazing wedding suppliers from all over the UK.

feeds.title: Gay Wedding Blog
feeds.description: My name is Eva, I'm a photographer by day, and now a blogger by night. Through the blog and the Supplier Directory, I want to showcase great wedding styles but also introduce some amazing wedding suppliers from all over the UK. You can also read some wedding planning advice from specialists and see gorgeous real weddings.

feeds.title: Love My Dress » LGBTQA+ Weddings
feeds.description: Love My Dress shares LGBTQA+ wedding & bridal fashion inspiration articles in this segment. Love My Dress is a soulful platform for weddings, founded by Annabel Beeforth. We encourage heartfelt wedding celebrations through honest storytelling and thoughtful, uplifting, relatable content.
